events.label: 2026-09-16 Autumn Kick-Off Quiz Night
events.old:
Get ready for a proper night out at the Autumn Kick-Off Quiz Night at The Anchor on Wednesday, 16 September 2026, starting at 7pm. Join us for a lively evening filled with questions, laughter, and a bit of friendly competition. Whether you're a quiz master or just in it for the fun, this night is all about getting involved and having a laugh.

Expect a mix of varied rounds covering everything from general knowledge to music, TV, and random trivia. It's not a stuffy sit-down quiz; think fast-paced questions to keep everyone on their toes. Gather your team of up to six people and dive into the fun!

Peter Pitcher will be your host for the evening, bringing plenty of energy and a few surprises along the way. He knows how to keep things moving and ensure everyone has a great time. So, whether you're there to win or just enjoy the atmosphere, you'll feel right at home.

The bar will be serving up drinks all night, and the pub is open from 12pm, and our full dinner menu is available from 4pm to 9pm. We recommend ordering your food before the quiz kicks off at 7pm to get settled in with your meal. It's a great chance to grab a bite and a drink while you gear up for the quiz.

Arrive by 6:45pm to get seated and ready to quiz by 7pm sharp. Entry is just £3 per person, cash only, and we highly recommend booking your table to make sure you get a spot. You can book online or give us a call at 01753 682707.

The Anchor is located in Stanwell Moor with plenty of free parking available. It’s close to both Heathrow and Staines, making it easy to swing by for an evening of fun and quizzes. Bring your mates, grab some food, and let’s make it a night to remember!

events.label: 2026-09-25 Lovely Jubbly: Only Fools and Horses Charity Quiz Night
events.old:
The Anchor is partnering with the Stanwell Moor Community Wellbeing Garden for a special Only Fools and Horses charity quiz night in aid of Macmillan Cancer Support. Join us on Friday 25 September from 7pm to 9.30pm for classic quotes, themed questions, plenty of laughs and a good cause at the heart of the night. Every penny from the £3 quiz entry fee will be donated to Macmillan Cancer Support.

Expect four themed rounds with ten questions in each, covering iconic moments, favourite characters, classic catchphrases and deeper cuts for proper fans. There will also be a quick interactive game using one phone per player. Quizmaster Peter Pitcher will keep the questions moving and the atmosphere lively, whether you know every episode or simply fancy a fun Friday night with friends.

Arrive from 6:30pm for a 7pm start. The pub is open from 12pm, and our full dinner menu is available from 4pm to 9pm, so come early, order some food and settle in before the first round. Food and drinks are ordered at the bar.

Teams can have up to six players. Entry is £3 per person, paid in cash on arrival, while the bar takes card as usual. Booking is strongly recommended because this event is expected to be busy. Walk-ins are welcome where space allows, and we will do our best to help solo players and pairs join a team.

The winning team will receive a £25 bar voucher, and second-to-last place will receive a bottle of wine. All prizes are provided separately, so no quiz entry fees will be used to pay for them.

The Anchor is in Stanwell Moor, close to Staines and Heathrow, with free on-site parking. Dress-up is welcome but not required. The pub is dog-friendly, and the bar and dining area are step-free from the car park.

This is an independently organised fundraising event in aid of Macmillan Cancer Support and is not organised by Macmillan. It is a themed fan quiz and is not an official Only Fools and Horses event. Macmillan Cancer Support is a registered charity in England and Wales (261017), Scotland (SC039907) and the Isle of Man (604).

events.label: 2026-10-07 A Hint of Halloween Quiz Night
events.old:
Quiz Night returns to The Anchor in Stanwell Moor on Wednesday, 7 October 2026, starting at 7pm and finishing at about 9.30pm. This remains our normal varied Quiz Night, with only a small Halloween hint. A few light spooky touches may creep into the questions, but it is not a fully themed quiz and teams do not need specialist horror knowledge.

The quiz is fast, friendly and easy to join, with rounds covering general knowledge, music, television, film, pictures and random facts. Expect quick-fire moments and a one-phone-per-player mini challenge. Teams can have up to six people, and newcomers are just as welcome as regular quiz teams.

Entry is £3 per person and is paid in cash on arrival. The first-place team wins a £25 bar voucher, while second-to-last place receives a bottle of wine. Booking is strongly recommended so we can prepare a table for each team.

The pub is open from 12pm. Our full dinner menu is served from 4pm to 9pm. Arrive early, order food and settle in before the quiz starts at 7pm. Food remains available through most of the event, although ordering before the first question is recommended.

The Anchor is in Stanwell Moor, close to Heathrow and Staines, with free parking on site. Book the number of players attending, bring £3 cash per person for quiz entry and enjoy a lively midweek pub quiz with food, drinks and friendly competition.

events.label: 2026-10-16 Screams & Soundtracks: Classic Horror Music Bingo
events.old:
Screams & Soundtracks: Classic Horror Music Bingo comes to The Anchor in Stanwell Moor on Friday, 16 October 2026, running from 7pm to 10pm. Classic horror soundtracks, spooky favourites, monster hits and darkly fun party anthems take over both rounds. The theme is strong, theatrical and playful rather than genuinely frightening, so everyone can enjoy the atmosphere.

Nikki Manfadge hosts two fully themed rounds of Music Bingo, mixing recognisable tracks, singalong favourites and surprises. Listen to each song clip, match it to the titles or artists on your card and mark the square. You do not need expert music knowledge to join in.

The night includes prizes, quick games, crowd participation, singing, dancing and Nikki's usual cheeky energy. Dressing up is encouraged, and teams can earn extra points for getting involved with the theme. A full costume is welcome, but even a small themed touch counts.

Entry is £5 per person and is paid in cash on arrival. Music Bingo uses communal seating, so book every person attending and we will prepare the shared event layout. Walk-ins are welcome when space allows, but advance booking is strongly recommended.

The pub is open from 12pm. Our full dinner menu is served from 4pm to 9pm. Arrive early, enjoy food and get settled before the first round starts at 7pm. The Anchor has free parking and is close to Heathrow and Staines, making this an easy Friday night out for friends, families, neighbours and work groups.

events.label: 2026-11-13 Sequins & Showstoppers: Strictly-Season Music Bingo
events.old:
Get ready for a huge night of fun at The Anchor with Sequins & Showstoppers: Strictly-Season Music Bingo on Friday, 13 November from 7pm. This isn’t just any bingo night; it’s packed with ballroom classics, glitterball anthems and plenty of laughs. Grab your mates, put on your sequins, and get ready for a proper night out.

Expect two fully themed rounds where you’ll listen to song clips and match them to your bingo card. Whether you know the tunes or just love a good singalong, it’s all about having a laugh and getting involved. There’ll be plenty of surprises along the way, so keep your eyes peeled!

Nikki will be your host for the evening, bringing her cheeky energy and crowd interaction to keep the night moving. With quick games, cheeky moments, and prizes up for grabs, you’ll be laughing and singing the night away.

The pub is open from 12pm, the bar remains open throughout the evening, and our full dinner menu is available from 4pm until 9pm, so feel free to arrive early, grab a bite, and settle in before the bingo kicks off. It’s the perfect way to fuel up for a night of fun.

Entry is just £5 per person, paid in cash on arrival. We use communal seating, so make sure to book for everyone in your group to keep you all together. You can book your spots on our website or give us a call at 01753 682707. Walk-ins are welcome if there’s space, but booking is the best way to guarantee your spot.

Find us in Stanwell Moor, just a short drive from Heathrow and Staines-upon-Thames. With free parking available, it’s easy to get here, so don’t miss out on the fun!

events.label: 2026-11-20 Tinsel & Tipples Christmas Tasting Night
events.old:
Get ready for a festive evening out at The Anchor with our Tasting Night on 20 November from 7pm to 10pm. It’s a proper Christmas night out, filled with six blind tastings, a delicious Christmas supper, and loads of fun.

You’ll kick things off with hot mulled cider as you settle in. Then, Peter Pitcher will guide you through the evening, introducing each drink without revealing what’s in your glass. You’ll taste six different alcoholic drinks, rate them live on your phone, and enjoy some great stories behind each one.

As the drinks flow, so does the laughter. The full Christmas supper will keep you fuelled, featuring a giant Yorkshire wrap filled with all the festive favourites. Plus, there’ll be a festive quiz and even a chance to make your own cocktail later on!

With only 25 seats available, this is a special evening designed for fun and interaction. Tickets are £40 if you book in advance or £45 on the night if there are seats left. Arrive from 6:30pm for a 7pm start.

The Anchor is in Stanwell Moor with free parking available. If you’re coming from Staines or West Drayton, you’re just a short drive away. Don’t miss out on this chance to kick off the festive season right!
